title: Typed contract and pure policy core

previous_iteration_review.subject: docs(governance): establish project foundation [MTM-001]
previous_iteration_review.result: MTM-001 governance, graphs, toolchain, Rust bootstrap, golden source contract, and Git checks passed before MTM-002 began.

authority.component_scope: MTM-reboot typed pure contract and policy core

implemented: Stable error categories, payload shape, and Native/workflow/domain/LaTeX enum wire values
JSON-schema subset used by Re-CTM tools including const, oneOf, anyOf, type, lengths, pattern, enum, numeric bounds, arrays, required fields, and additionalProperties
Secret-key/value redaction, SHA-256 token fingerprints, and byte summaries
OAuth origin, redirect URI, strict TryCloudflare origin, and workspace-path policy
Native command permission ordering, sensitive environment detection, and inline interpreter recognition
Patch envelope parsing and deterministic update-hunk application
Bounded single and batch JSON conformance entry points with no stateful side effects

conformance.interpretation: A5 resource non-regression passed. No A6 speed claim is made because Rust cold-process elapsed time was slightly higher in this bootstrap harness.

failures_retained.cause: A test-only BTreeSet import was in production scope and two tests used the prohibited expect_err helper.
failures_retained.resolution: Moved the import into the test module and rewrote assertions without panic-style helpers.

failures_retained.cause: The first Rust risky-environment list included GIT_SSH_COMMAND, which was not present in the frozen Re-CTM source contract.
failures_retained.resolution: Removed the extra policy instead of silently broadening behavior.

failures_retained.cause: The Rust URL parser exposed IPv6 loopback host as [::1], while Python urlsplit().hostname exposes ::1.
failures_retained.resolution: Normalized URL-library representation before applying the existing loopback policy; all 135 cases then matched.

failures_retained.cause: rustfmt required only presentation changes in url_policy.rs.
failures_retained.resolution: Applied cargo fmt and reran the full gate successfully.

failures_retained.cause: The missing-receipt governance test reused the now-approved real MTM-003 node and therefore triggered TODO inconsistency before the intended receipt assertion.
failures_retained.resolution: Replaced the lifecycle-coupled fixture with a synthetic MTM-900 milestone; the completed-state full gate then passed.

acceptance.A0: passed: format, Clippy -D warnings, 19 Rust tests, six governance tests, migration/architecture validators, bootstrap and Git checks
acceptance.A1: passed: 135-case source corpus and immutable reference SHA-256
acceptance.A2: passed: exact normalized result and full error-payload parity with no Git-visible shadow side effect
acceptance.A5: passed: seven-sample bounded Python/Rust comparison within absolute and non-regression ceilings
acceptance.A3: not applicable to the side-effect-free milestone
acceptance.A4: not applicable to the side-effect-free milestone

dependencies.review: Dependencies are locked. url's Unicode/IDNA transitive footprint is accepted to avoid unsafe hand-written URL authority parsing; none performs runtime network access.

rollback: Revert MTM-002 or bypass mtm-core and run the frozen Python pure reference. No persistent state, child process, OAuth token, workflow transition, or artifact migration exists.
